class.name: HTMLWheelEvent
class.brief_description: A cancelable wheel event with pixel deltas.
class.description: Dispatched before the host [HTMLLabel] applies wheel scrolling. Positive [member delta] values move down and right. Each Godot wheel step maps to 36 pixels. Calling [method HTMLEvent.prevent_default] prevents the label's default wheel scrolling. The event uses [constant DELTA_MODE_PIXEL].

constants.constant: The delta values are measured in pixels.

members.member: The wheel delta in pixels. Positive Y scrolls down and positive X scrolls right.
The units used by [member delta]. This event always uses [constant DELTA_MODE_PIXEL].
